claim.statement: Google's current environment guide says Jules can infer setup for simple repositories or run a repository-specific setup script, and a successful Run and Snapshot stores an environment snapshot for future tasks on that repository.

source.title: Jules environment setup
source.locator: Overview; Add a setup script; Test your setup script; Environment Snapshots

limitations: The guide describes setup paths but does not establish which path a particular repository will use.
No setup script was submitted and no snapshot was created or inspected.
unknowns: Snapshot contents, encryption, retention, invalidation, tenant isolation and restoration completeness are unknown.
The exact commands inferred by Jules and the side effects of a repository setup script are unknown.
